hook: Your sunrise on Mercury can run backwards.
title: On Mercury, the Sun rises, then backs up
description:
At certain spots on Mercury, the Sun rises, stops, slides back toward the horizon, then rises again. It happens because Mercury's orbit speed beats its slow spin when it is closest to the Sun. If you watch an animation of the Sun's path, you can see it.

#Shorts #Space #Mercury
comment_prompt: Would you wait for this sunrise? Yes or no

scenes.narration: Mercury orbits fast but spins slowly.

scenes.narration: Close to the Sun, its orbit outruns its spin.
